copy.curiosityHook: Can two young heroes pull off world-saving teamwork when their own sworn secrecy keeps them entirely in the dark?
copy.description: When a guardian of magical jewels grants superpowers to an awkward girl and a popular boy, the pair must defend Paris under a strict condition: neither can ever discover who the other really is.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast, colorful family fantasy packed with exciting superhero action and engaging romantic tension.
copy.whyWatch: Jeremy Zag delivers a brisk animated fantasy balancing kinetic superhero spectacle with the romantic friction of two partners concealing their true selves.

allowedMaterial: Awkward girl and popular boy transformed into superheroes by a guardian of magical jewels
Requirement of strict secrecy regarding their real identities
Action, romance, and fantasy genre dynamics
